Frequently asked questions

Simple answers before you get started.

What if an approved file is view-only?

That may be intentional. Keep the approved original unchanged. If you need an editable copy, use the permitted copy option or request access from the file owner. Don't rebuild it from a screenshot.

How should I share finished artwork?

Check the names, dates, size, brand and approval first. Share the exported file or an approved view link, not an editable master. For external or high-visibility work, check with Design before publishing.

Can I use the designs shown here?

Start from the relevant event, project, brand or file type. Open the approved source linked there. A preview shows what exists, but is not an editable or downloadable original.

When should I ask Design for help?

For a new visual concept, important external pitch, complex illustration, or work without an approved template. For small updates to an approved source, change only the confirmed details. If it needs a new layout, brand treatment or creative concept, request Design support.

What can I safely use AI for?

Use ChatGPT or Gemini to plan outlines, shorten copy, or draft headlines. Do not upload confidential information to tools unless approved. Verify facts, names, dates and tone. Use Canva for the actual branded design.

Does Lighthouse save my work or share it with colleagues?

Mission drafts are kept in this browser when storage is available. They do not sync to Notion or other devices, and other colleagues do not see them. Download a personal task backup if you want a copy. Avoid putting confidential details in prompts unless the intended AI tool is approved for them.

Where are the latest official files?

Notion and Canva are the sources of truth. Lighthouse links you to those approved directories and provides a small selection of previews. If a source link is missing, request Design support rather than reusing an unapproved screenshot.
